{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes error messages returned by descriptor and scan RPC methods such as getdescriptorinfo and scantxoutset (src/rpc/util.cpp and functional tests).",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents RPC error strings from echoing raw private key material and xprvs into error responses. The RPC category explicitly prioritizes security of the interface, including 'exposure of sensitive data', which occurs when error responses are stored in logs or monitoring services where request bodies are not."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/util/bip32.cpp for a single line (+1/-1) to adjust keypath error reporting as part of descriptor sanitization.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The single-line change to bip32.cpp is an incidental edit following the descriptor error sanitization rather than a change to shared utility infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies descriptor parsing and wallet import/funding logic (src/script/descriptor.cpp, src/wallet/imports.cpp, src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp) to prevent key leakage.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "fund safety",
      "rationale": "Stops raw WIF private keys and xprv substrings from being reflected in wallet error responses when descriptor parsing or derivation fails. Protecting secret keys from leaking into application logs or shared diagnostics directly impacts wallet key safety."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
